learning_objective: 🎯 Discover how roads, bridges, electricity, and the internet act as a massive super-engine powering India's incredible growth!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Infrastructure is the physical framework that keeps a country running. Think of it as the skeleton of our nation, including highways, railways, hospitals, schools, and power plants.
India has one of the largest railway networks on the entire planet! Trains and modern highways connect tiny rural villages to huge mega-cities, making travel and trade super easy.
Electricity is the invisible magic that lights up our homes and powers massive factories. Today, India is working hard to use more green energy from the sun and wind to protect our Earth!
Infrastructure is not just made of concrete anymore. High-speed internet cables, mobile towers, and satellites connect us globally, allowing students to learn online and businesses to grow instantly.

fun_activity.title: 🏗️ Neighborhood Architect!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a colorful map of your neighborhood. Now, add one missing piece of infrastructure that you think would help everyone, like a solar-powered bus stop or a new community library!

quick_recap: ⭐ Infrastructure includes the basic physical systems like roads, water supply, and power grids.
⭐ Strong transportation networks help move people and goods quickly across the vast country.
⭐ Energy is essential for development, and India is shifting towards cleaner, renewable power.
⭐ Digital infrastructure like the internet is transforming how Indians communicate and learn.
